_comment: Copy this to mcp_config.json and replace every /path/to/... with your own. mcp_config.json is gitignored because it holds absolute per-machine paths. This registry is what the PYTHON framework reads (src/core/mcp_manager.py); Claude Code reads .mcp.json instead, which is a different file with a different schema. The key below must be mcp_servers, not mcpServers: the loader reads mcp_servers and a file with the other spelling registers nothing and says nothing.
_geology: The SSURGO soil server at mcp/geology-mcp/ is deliberately NOT registered. It was retired 2026-08-17: a soil survey stops at about 1.5 m, so a deep column built from it was 88 to 97 percent extrapolated. mcp/weather-mcp/ is likewise unregistered. Both still run if launched by hand.
_models: elm and pflotran are the two servers that can drive a whole study (src/core/model_servers.py RUNNABLE). Without at least one of them registered, reception has no model to name and no study can start.

elm.description: E3SM Land Model, 1-D columns: builds and submits CIME cases. Needs an E3SM source tree, a scratch filesystem and a working sbatch; no web credentials. The long timeout is deliberate, since a case build is slow.

pflotran.description: PFLOTRAN: variably-saturated flow and reactive transport. NOT in this repository. It is a console script installed from the separate repo reaction_sandbox_mcp (branch compy-port), so this entry is dead until that is pip-installed into your environment. Note there is no args key: the console script takes none.

usgs_water.description: USGS site discovery, streamflow and groundwater levels. Free and keyless; USGS_API_KEY is optional and only raises the rate limit.

terrain.description: USGS 3DEP elevation and watershed boundaries. Free and keyless. This is what turns a basin name or HUC code into a real bounding box.

snotel.description: NRCS SNOTEL snow water equivalent. Free and keyless.

daymet.description: Daymet V4 daily 1 km weather from ORNL DAAC. Free and keyless. Note it returns HTTP 200 and the whole archive for an out-of-range year, and its calendar is always 365 days.

ameriflux.description: AmeriFlux eddy-covariance towers: ET comparison sites. Discovery is open; downloading series needs AMERIFLUX_USER_ID and AMERIFLUX_EMAIL.

hydrodata.description: ParFlow CONUS2 water-table depth (1 km) and Fan 2013 wells via HydroFrame. Needs `pip install hf_hydrodata` and a free Princeton email plus PIN registered once per machine; see the server's data_status() tool.
